description: Unit test class for the TimeDate utility class, testing methods related to date and time formatting, retrieval of user preferences, and time manipulation functions within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: TimeDateTest
classes.description: Test suite for the TimeDate class, verifying correct handling of date/time formats, preferences, and conversions in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: testget_date_format
methods.description: Verifies that get_date_format correctly retrieves the user's date format preference.

methods.name: testget_time_format
methods.description: Verifies that get_time_format correctly retrieves the user's time format preference.

methods.name: testget_date_time_format
methods.description: Verifies that get_date_time_format correctly retrieves the combined date and time format based on user preferences.

methods.name: testget_first_day_of_week
methods.description: Checks that get_first_day_of_week returns the preferred first day of the week.

methods.name: testget_first_day_of_week_defaultResponse
methods.description: Checks the default value for first day of the week when no user preferences are set.

methods.name: testmerge_date_time
methods.description: Ensures that merge_date_time combines two format strings into a single date-time format.

methods.name: testsplit_date_time
methods.description: Verifies that split_date_time splits a date-time string into separate date and time formats.

methods.name: testhttpTime
methods.description: Tests that httpTime produces an RFC 2616 compliant timestamp.

methods.name: testto_db_time
methods.description: Checks that to_db_time extracts only the time component from a datetime string.

methods.name: testto_db_date_time
methods.description: Validates that to_db_date_time returns an array with the date and time parts of a datetime string.

methods.name: testsplitTime
methods.description: Tests splitting a simple time string into its components.

methods.name: testsplitTimeWith24HourDateTime
methods.description: Tests splitting a datetime string with 24-hour time into components.

methods.name: testsplitTimeWithPM
methods.description: Tests splitting a datetime string with AM/PM into components, including the AM/PM indicator.
